seed: The talking sample at Next defaults, nothing switched and nothing picked or hovered. Its sound under V1 shows a white diamond at each fade, 12 points, ringed in the lane's own cyan, as video-audio.html draws its .fade on every lane, photographed in dark and in light. Then each handle is grabbed the way a hand does: the trim grip under the start diamond still trims, the diamond still fades, the level line right beside the diamond still moves the level and leaves the fade alone, and a level point (11 points, filled cyan, ringed in the panel colour) still drags.

steps.note: Nothing picked, the pointer nowhere near: the sound under V1 shows its fade in diamond at its start, white ringed in cyan, without a hover
The same in light: the diamond reads as clearly on the light window
The trim grip under the start diamond trims the clip: the diamond did not take the press, the fade is still nothing
The start diamond dragged right to about a second: it rides the corner where the level line comes up out of the fade
The level line grabbed a hand's width right of the diamond moves the level down; the fade stays at a second, so the diamond did not steal the press
A click on the line pins a level point there: 11 points, filled cyan, ringed in the panel colour
The level point dragged down: the line dips to it and comes back up either side
The sample music dropped in lands on a sound track of its own under the talk's: its diamonds are ringed in purple, the mock's second lane colour, and the talk's stay cyan
